annotation.title_clean: PL n. 357/2024 - Altera a Lei nº 9.394/1996 para dispor sobre a inclusão das atividades de Inteligência Artificial em cursos destinados a quem tenha concluído o ensino médio
annotation.title_en: Bill No. 357/2024 - Amends Law No. 9,394/1996 to provide for the inclusion of Artificial Intelligence activities in courses for those who have completed secondary education
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Câmara dos Deputados (Dep. Lucio Mosquini, MDB/RO)
annotation.summary_en: Brazilian bill amending the national education guidelines law (LDB, Law 9,394/1996) to add Art. 36-E, making AI education, including digital literacy, computing, programming and robotics, a curricular component of post-secondary technical vocational courses. Justified by labour-market demand, competitiveness and sustainable development.
key_provisions_or_claims: Adds Art. 36-E to LDB making AI education a curricular component of subsequent technical vocational courses
AI education covers digital literacy, computing, programming, robotics and other digital skills
Education systems have one year to regulate and implement
Justification stresses workforce demand, global competitiveness and sustainable development
